incidents.name: LocalTrader LCTExchange missing access control
incidents.notes: The closed-source LCTExchange exposes a privileged transfer/settlement entry point without an owner check, so the attacker called it directly and moved the exchange's BNB and LCT out.

sources.ref: onchain review: LCTExchange 0xcE3e12bD77DD54E20a18cB1B94667F3E697bea06 created 2023-05-11T10:36:27Z by 0xdc02a3b51d86d7a19ad24082c0c82affe8412913, unrelated to attack sender 0xd771dfa8fa59bd2d1251a0481fca0cf216276dd7; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. DeFiHackLabs carries two PoCs (LocalTrader_exp and LocalTrader2_exp) for the same four-transaction incident; one row is recorded. lossUsd converts the 384 BNB reported: 384 BNB x $313.66 at incidentTimestamp 1684841942 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $120,445.
